title: Lore Studio Bridge
description: Connects Foundry to Lore Studio on the GM's computer: logs chat, rolls and combat for session recaps, and receives journal pages from Lore Studio. Also runs your scenery: backgrounds fitted to 1920×1080, crossfading with the time of day, time-of-day sounds and Calendaria weather through FXMaster.

recommends.reason: Scenery follows Calendaria's clock, sunrise, sunset and weather.
Plays Calendaria's weather as rain, snow, fog and more.
